The '''''Rightful Eran''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group that was active in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the pirates flew the ''Rightful Eran'' to [[I-9]], an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] that was located within the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], and the ship was gutted for spare parts.
